event_records.description: Leila and the prospective advisor are at an impasse in equity negotiations. Leila is considering how to respond to the advisor's request for 1%.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder of a startup. She is negotiating equity with a prospective advisor who has asked for 1% after she offered 0.3%. Her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. The company's standard advisor template vests over two years. Leila wants to reach an agreement within a month.

prospective_advisor.name: Prospective Advisor
prospective_advisor.persona_brief:
You are Prospective Advisor.
The prospective advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions for the company. He has asked for 1% equity and is considering the offer. He may have other opportunities or expectations.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that both Leila and the prospective advisor have signed an advisor agreement. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
